messages.text:
I have oriented myself with the current work and the product context:

- The product is "Chomp," a browser-playable Pac-Man clone with backend and frontend.
- The last release was version 1.2.2, deployed and live at http://chomp.company-product.k8s.orb.local:8080.
- There are several open cards, some overdue, mostly features and bugs related to ghost AI and UI overlays.
- The QA agent listed the existing test files for various modules.

Next, please confirm if you want me to run all tests to check the current product quality before any deployment or if you want me to deploy a specific version or card. Also, let me know if there is a particular card you want me to focus on for release.
